label: lte-native-triggered-20261019-01
method: Exact-byte saved native trace, corrected body timestamp offset0; FDD four-subframe schedule/receive join with identity, frame/subframe and <=100ms time bound; compare nearby ACK records. No new RF run.
timestamp_correction: Previous waveform.json schedule.timestamp_ns was parsed at offset4 in a record body without the length prefix. Those schedule timestamps are invalid. This file re-parses at offset0 and validates nsec. Previous frame-based counts, waveform fits and independently parsed input_timestamp_ns remain unchanged.
limits: No actual receiver NDI/RV/soft-buffer reset or turbo iteration count in this capture. Expected RV0,2,3,1 and inherited NDI are source-based inferences, not measured decoder state. Native frame/sample joins do not prove absolute RF alignment. Decode failures are not telemetry packet losses or an established registration-loss cause.

new_data_toggle.finding: LTE-M new transmissions toggle oldNDI_UL and set MCS4/TBS from six RBs.

retry_rv.finding: Source maps rounds0..3 to RV0,2,3,1 and supplies the same mapping to grant and receiver config. Runtime RV/NDI not in saved trace.

retry_exhaustion.finding: MAC resets round after failure at round3; observed four-failure groups are consistent with this path.

phy_state_cleanup.finding: On decode abort with round>=3, PHY clears status/handled/mask and resets round. The saved trace lacks these runtime field values.

existing_grant_trace_limit.finding: LTE-M ENB_PHY_ULSCH_UE_DCI reports a legacy calculated HARQ ID marked TODO and round=-1, while actual dci_alloc HARQ uses rel13->harq_process. This is a diagnostic field limitation, not evidence of an on-air grant error. Saved capture did not enable this event.

source_review.next_observation: Add narrow diagnostic-only events at actual grant construction, receive configuration and decode completion: identity/frame, HARQ, NDI, RV, TBS, MCS, allocation, round, new-data/soft-buffer-reset decision, decode return/abort status. Keep original radio tree/binary and all production MCU firmware unchanged.
